Diseases
are temporary or semi-permanent detrimental effect inflicted on a character. Diseases can be obtained during fighting with certain creatures, or can be gained simply by exploring an environment unprotected. Some diseases like
Broken Bone
can stack, but most do not.
Diseases
can be cured through specialized potions or by using an appropriate
First Aid
ability.
Basic
Aged (Disease)
- Your body feels unnaturally old. -5% Max Health, -5% Max Power This is a simple disease.
Feeble Fever
- You've been infected with a basic disease! It is permanent until cured. -3 Max Health
Fevered Trismus
- Your skin feels furry and your ears seem larger than normal. But it's probably nothing to worry about. Okay, you might want to get this checked out quickly...This is a basic disease that can be removed with Cure Disease.
Frog Flu
- Your skin is clammy, your breathing is shallow, and your head hurts. This is a basic disease. It is permanent until cured. -5 Max Power.
Lice
- You've been infected with a basic disease! It is permanent until cured. -1 Max Power, -1 Hygiene.
Rotbelly
- You've been infected with a basic disease! It is permanent until cured. -3 Max Power.
Swamp Tick
- You've been infected with a basic disease! It is permanent until cured. -1% Max Health.
Varleech
- You've been infected with a basic disease! It is permanent until cured. -1% Max Health
Complex
Creakliver
- You've been infected with a complex disease! It is permanent until cured. -12 Max Health.
Lunatic Shakes
- You've been infected with a complex disease! It is permanent until cured. -5 Max Power.
Mummy Ache
- You feel nauseated and can't seem to concentrate. -10% Max Power. This is a complex disease. It is permanent until cured.
Mummy Limp
- Something is wrong with your foot. It hurts too much to carry your full weight! -33% Sprint Speed. This is a complex disease. It is permanent until cured.
Mummy Rot
- Your flesh seems weak and bruises very easily. You take 33% more damage from Crushing attacks. This is a complex disease. It is permanent until cured.
Mummy Wilt
- Your muscles have atrophied. Your melee attacks deal -10% damage. This is a complex disease. It is permanent until cured.
Advanced
Broken Bone
- A bone is shattered! All abilities cost +1 Power. This is an advanced disease. It is permanent until cured.
Roundworms
- You've been infected with an advanced disease! It is permanent until cured. 10% more vulnerable to Nature and Trauma damage.
Slimy Tremors
- You've been infected with an advanced disease! It is permanent until cured. -10 Max Power.
Word of Power: Leprosy
- Speaking this word gives you leprosy. Leprosy is an advanced disease that is permanent until cured. -50 Max Health.
Serious
Hexapox
- You've been infected with a serious disease! It is permanent until cured. 3% of your attacks automatically miss.
Other
Feeling Ill
- You're feeling ill. But it's not the normal kind of ill... You are taking continuous unblockable damage (This can be treated with Treat Disease 3 or higher.
Curse
A
Curse
is a semi-permanent, detrimental effect inflicted on a character mostly by certain bosses or potions. The primary way to remove a
Curse
is by defeating the boss that cursed you with it. Most curses can also be cured with an expensive
Minor Panacea
.
Beast Forms
are not Curses, although some curable Curses exist that bestow Beast Forms.
Druid
forms are considered to be a
Curse
.
List of Boss Curses
Aged
(
Claudia
) - Your body feels unnaturally older. Slightly wiser, but mostly just older. -10% Max Health, +3% Max Power This is a permanent curse; you must defeat Claudia to remove it.
Baruti's Curse
(
Baruti
) - You're feeling sort of itchy and sick. This is a permanent curse; you must defeat Baruti to remove it.
Bovine Reaction
(
Maronesa
) - You feel your innards shifting... you're turning into a cow!
Brain Fungus
(
Unfun Guy
) - Your body is not entirely under your control! When you attack fungal creatures, you pull your punches. -10% Damage vs. Fungoids. This is a permanent curse; defeat Unfun Guy to remove it.
Butterfly Transformation
([[]]) - You've turned into a bug! Fortunately this will wear off... Suffer all fae racial penalties + 10% Nature & Psychology Base Damage
Combat Disorientation
(
Dementia Puck
) - You're prone to forgetting your plan of attack. This is a permanent curse; you must defeat Dementia Puck to remove it.
Concussion Damage
(
Forgotten Loading Golem
) - Occasionally you lose motor coordination and can't attack. This is a permanent curse; you must defeat Forgotten Loading Golem to remove it.
Conduction Aphasia
(
Timothy Elerimon
) - You seem to have developed a speech disorder. This is a permanent curse; to remove it you must defeat the Timothy Elerimon.
Crystallized Organs
(
Guardian Crystal
) - Too much magic crystal has made its way into your body. -10% Health and Armor, Nature Attacks Deal +10% damage This is a permanent curse; to remove it you must defeat the Red Guardian Crystal.
Darkened Heart
(
Khyrulek's True Form
) - An evil magic has infested your heart. It still beats, but is prone to failing under stress. You occasionally lose half your health while in combat. This is a permanent curse; you must defeat Khyrulek's True Form to remove it.
Darkness Imbued
(
Lord Sedgewick
) - Magical darkness clings to you wherever you go. +10% Evasion; Enemies gain +20% Evasion against you. This is a permanent curse; you must defeat Lord Sedgewick to remove it"
Darkness Rebuked
(
Peacemaster Guztok
) - You've lost the ability to fully channel necromantic energy. Darkness Damage -50%. This is permanent; defeat Peacemaster Guztok to remove it.
Defiler of Enoyos
(
Sacrificial Scray
) - Touching water has become painful and distressing. You are stunned when entering water. This is a permanent curse; you must kill the
Sacrificial Scray
to remove it.
Egg Infestation
(
Gazluk Clutchmaster
) - Thousands of unfertilized Urak eggs have been injected under your flesh. They keep popping out... This is a permanent curse. You must defeat Gazluk Clutchmaster to remove it.
Fouled Lungs
(
The Fog
) - Your lungs have been permanently damaged. Abilities cost +3 Power to use. +2 Nature Mitigation. This is a permanent curse; to remove it you must defeat the The Fog.
Frosty Forever
(
Coldfeather
) - Magical ice has been embedded in your body. You sometimes lose half your health when not in a cold area. +25% Max Body Heat. This is permanent; defeat Coldfeather to remove it.
Gored Pockets
(
Rhino Guardian
) - A rhino has gored a giant hole in your storage devices! -5 Inventory. This is a permanent curse; you must defeat Guardian Rhino to remove it.
Haunted
(
Ursula
) - Hmm, you seem to have a guest inside your head.
Lost Direction Sense
(
Asterion
) - Which way is which? You keep getting turned all around. This is a permanent curse; you must defeat Asterion to remove it.
Magnacephalus
(
Gajus
) - Your head and brain have grown! You can't wear headgear, but you gain +25 Power. This is a permanent curse; you must defeat Gajus to remove it.
Mantis Aversion
(
Imarak
) - Your body is not entirely under your control! When you attack a mantis, you stun yourself. (Once per minute max.) This is a permanent curse; defeat Imarak to remove it.
Nameless
(
Nameless Guardian
) - You can no longer speak your name aloud in chat. This is a permanent curse; to remove it you must defeat the Nameless Warrior.
Not So Smart Anymore
(
Sherzat
) - It takes a long time for you to gather your thoughts now, and your temper is getting worse. -50% Out of Combat Power Regeneration, +5 Direct Damage. This is a permanent curse; you must defeat Sherzat to remove it.
Permanent Spore Damage
(
Tremor
) - You're having trouble remembering how to perform even the most basic attacks.
Basic Attack Reuse Time +15 seconds
This is a permanent curse; you must defeat Tremor to remove it
Personal Rainstorm
(
Tidal
) - You're all soggy! Your fire attacks deal -50% damage. You take +5 Nature, +5 Cold, and -5 Fire damage from enemy attacks. This is a permanent curse; you must defeat Tidal to remove it.
Poor Student
(
Vemuta the Lecturer
) - You interrupted class and the lecturer stole part of your brain in retaliation. -10% XP Earned. This is permanent; defeat Vemuta to remove it.
Pro-Ranalon
(
Doctrine-Keeper
) - You've been indoctrinated into the culture of the ranalon race. This is a permanent curse; you must defeat the Ranalon Doctrine Enforcer to remove it.
Rotten Attitude
(
Scion of Discord
) - When in groups, you've become petulant, arrogant, short-tempered, and prone to saying things you later regret. This is a permanent curse; you must defeat the Scion of Discord to remove it.
Severe Agoraphobia
(
Ratkin King (SqUUeak)
) - You've become so afraid of the outdoors that you periodically suffer anxiety bursts. Staying indoors is comforting, however. Periodically suffer -50 Power outdoors. Periodically gain +10 Power indoors. This is a permanent curse; you must defeat Ratkin King [SqUUeak] to remove it.
Slimed Legs
(
The Big Slime
) - Your legs are coated in warm, sticky, self-replicating slime! Movement Speed -3, Cold Mitigation +3. This is a permanent curse; you must defeat The Big Slime to remove it.
Slimed Legs
(
The Shower Slime
) - Your legs are coated in warm, sticky, self-replicating slime! Movement Speed -5, Cold Mitigation +5. This is a permanent curse; you must defeat The Shower Slime to remove it.
Spider Phobia
(
The Problem Spider
) - You've become deathly afraid of spiders, and in fact all arthropods seem way too icky to fight. You can't fully engage them in combat. -33% Direct Damage vs. Arthropods This is a permanent curse; you must defeat the Problem Spider to remove it.
Spirit Virus
(
Dalvos's Astral Projection
) - Your spirit has been infected with a dark virus. Suffer +20% damage from Darkness and Psychic attacks. Deal +8% Darkness damage. This effect is permanent; you must disconnect Dalvos's Astral Spirit to remove it.
Stolen Healing Potential
(
Healing-Suit Tester
) - Some of your innate recovery potential is gone. Major Healing abilities used on you restore -25% health. This is a permanent curse; you must defeat Healing-Suit Tester to remove it.
Toasted Flesh
(
Stolen War Golem
) - Your nerves have been damaged and are extra susceptible to heat. +25% Damage from Fire. This is a permanent curse; you must defeat Stolen War Golem to remove it.
Vipered
(
Tolmar the Snake Master
) - You were splashed with weird chemicals that don't seem to wash off! You suffer +20% damage from poison. This is a permanent curse; you must defeat Tolmar the Snake Master to remove it.
Winter Lethargy
(
Lethargy Puck
) - Feeling cold makes you want to stop moving and maybe take a nap. You lose 35 Power when attacked with Cold. This is a permanent curse; you must defeat
Lethargy Puck
to remove it.
Woozy
(
Zukelmux The Intransigent
) - Your head is ringing! Any little hit can disorient you. 50% chance to be briefly stunned whenever you are hit by a melee attack. This is a permanent curse; you must defeat Zukelmux The Intransigent to remove it.
Scorched
(
Hot Flash
) - Your armor has been scorched by intense flames making you take more fire damage. Your fire mitigation has been reduced by 10. You take +20% Fire damage from enemy attacks. This is a permanent curse; you must defeat Hot Flash to remove it.
Wrath of Enoyos
(
George
) - Enoyos has forbidden you from flowing in his waters freely. Your swimming speed has been reduced by 5. You lose 30% of your lung capacity when underwater. This is a permanent curse; you must defeat
George
to remove it.
List of Curse Conditions
Combat Echolocation
- You evade 7% of all attacks. Your movement speed is -1.
Echolocation
- You are echolocating.
Gruesome Spooky Punch
- You don't feel so good... you feel violent and angry, but weakened!
Mallard Form
- You're a duck! You can fly and your swimming is excellent, but your attack abilities are nearly nil.
Owl Form
- You're an owl! You can fly and your eyesight is great, but your attack abilities are nearly nil.
Raven Form
- You're a raven! You can fly, but your attack abilities are nearly nil.
Snow Raven
- You're a snow raven! You can fly and you have some resistance to cold weather, but your attack abilities are nearly nil.
